thread:
ana-partnerships: FYI — ByteCloud just moved our inbound carrier to Fri 12:00. Manifest changed, looks like a 48h slip from original ETA. We had a warehouse slot reserved for the APAC rack arrival. Need to decide reassign/reschedule ASAP.

mike-ops: ugh. do we have any buffer slots that week? :thinking_face:

priya-logistics: Realistically no. That slot was a hard hold for the dedicated commit. If it goes free, marketplace backfill will eat it within hours.

tom-sales: Who are the affected customers? If we reassign we need to notify at least two customers with dedicated windows.

ana-partnerships: Two Dedicated customers: AcmeHealth (priority) + Streamly. Acme has an SLA clause for contiguous rack delivery in the commit.

sanjay-engineering: If delivery shifts, we might be able to stagger installs across two smaller shipments to satisfy SLA? But that adds install ops.

priya-logistics: Install ops is fine but the port slot is the blocker. ByteCloud's supplier flagged a customs slot conflict so earliest arrival is Fri. I can ask for an expedited unload but extra cost.

mike-ops: What's the cost delta? If it's under the expedited threshold, we should pay to keep the slot for Acme.

ana-partnerships: Expedite estimate from ByteCloud: ~$14k + customs brokerage bump. That keeps original slot but vendor says we must confirm within 2h.

tom-sales: Acme will push back on extra fees. Can Redwood absorb or credit? We promised a stable commit price.

sanjay-engineering: Alternative: Reassign the reserved slot to Marketplace (short-term) and schedule Acme for next available contiguous slot in 7 days. Risk: Acme escalates.

priya-logistics: If we reassign, we can offer Acme a 10% credit and guaranteed priority on next two slots. That might be cheaper than $14k depending on lost revenue.

ana-partnerships: Quick poll: approve spend $14k to keep slot (option A) OR reassign slot and offer customer credit + priority (option B). Reply A or B.

mike-ops: A — keep slot. Avoid SLA churn.

priya-logistics: A if legal confirms no contractual penalty. Otherwise B.

tom-sales: B — let me pre-draft the customer comms and credit note.

sanjay-engineering: B from infra side; we can pipeline installs, but ops burden increases.

ana-partnerships: ops-bot: created incident-ticket #INC-2026-834 for slot decision and added timeline reminder in 1h.

ops-bot: incident-ticket #INC-2026-834 created by ana-partnerships. Reminder set for 1 hour.

ana-partnerships: We're split. I'll call ByteCloud to confirm if expedite can be reduced. Priya, put a tentative hold on marketplace backfill for that slot (48h hold). Tom, prep comms for both options.

priya-logistics: On it. Holding marketplace backfill (flagged in inventory system). Will update if ByteCloud reduces cost.

tom-sales: Drafts ready, dropping here after review. If we go B, I will send to Acme with the credit offer.

ana-partnerships: Update — ByteCloud dropped expedite to $9k if we accept within 30m. Decision time.

mike-ops: A. pay $9k.

priya-logistics: A from logistics. I'll confirm carrier instructions.

tom-sales: A — will prep customer notification but mention we kept original slot.

sanjay-engineering: A ok from infra.

ana-partnerships: Great. Priya, confirm payment path and update ops-bot with final manifest. Closing thread.

ops-bot: payment flag set, manifest updated when provided.
